title.value: OptEmbed: Learning Optimal Embedding Table for Click-through Rate Prediction
title.justification: The title accurately encapsulates the main focus and contribution of the paper, which is on the development of an optimal embedding table framework specifically for click-through rate (CTR) prediction.
title.quote: OptEmbed: Learning Optimal Embedding Table for Click-through Rate Prediction

extractions.description: This paper proposes a framework, OptEmbed, for learning optimal embedding tables for click-through rate (CTR) prediction in commercial recommender and online advertising systems. The framework addresses challenges such as memory efficiency and model performance by pruning redundant embeddings and searching for optimal embedding dimensions. The approach uses a uniform embedding dimension sampling scheme and an evolution search method based on a supernet. Experiments on public datasets show that OptEmbed produces compact embedding tables with improved performance.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing CTR prediction models for commercial recommender systems and online advertising, which is not directly related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
